audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Lucian levels 3, 6 and two-plus items on a 54.59% Singed matchup, while the whys under those exact rows say the level-3 lane 'hinges' on a bait (a coin flip, not a loss), that Insanity Potion lets you survive his rotation and root him, and that at full items the matchup is 'effectively unwinnable for him'. The full layer is also self-contradictory: labelled FAV but carrying the red tone and an 8.5/10 difficulty.
audit.why: Lucian's power is a level 1-3 poke lane; Singed's is everything after the proxy window opens. The prose already says exactly that and the sides were left pointing the other way.
audit.corrected: Lucian / Lucian / Skill / Singed / Singed / Singed / Singed, difficulty 5/10, and the favoured tone to match the FAV label.

audit.whatIsWrong: Relentless Pursuit is the ability the whole page is built around and its cooldown is never given, nor is the mechanic that makes tracking it hard.
audit.why: Riot Relentless Pursuit: 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, and 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.' So the printed number is a ceiling, not a plan — a Lucian who is attacking has it back far sooner. That is precisely why grounding beats baiting here. The Culling is 110/100/90 and is not mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Give the 16s and the fact that his own attacks shorten it, then point the player at Mega Adhesive rather than at a stopwatch.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly says to place Mega Adhesive where Relentless Pursuit will land. Mega Adhesive grounds — you place it on him, and then the dash does not happen at all.
audit.why: Riot Mega Adhesive: 'slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.' Riot Relentless Pursuit: 'Lucian quickly dashes a short distance.' Predicting a dash's landing spot is a guess; grounding the caster is not. This is the difference between a 50/50 read and a deterministic combo, and it is the single most useful thing Singed owns against a champion whose only escape is one dash.
audit.corrected: Goo on him, not ahead of him. Grounded, Relentless Pursuit will not cast; then Fling him back into the puddle and the landing roots him.

edits.before: Insanity Potion floods your stats; ghost into him, drop Mega Adhesive behind his Relentless Pursuit landing spot, and fling him back through your Poison Trail.
edits.after: Insanity Potion floods your stats; Ghost in and drop Mega Adhesive on him, not behind him — grounded, Relentless Pursuit will not cast and the Fling lands him in goo.

edits.before: Drop Mega Adhesive where Relentless Pursuit will land, then Fling him backward through your Poison Trail cloud
edits.after: Drop Mega Adhesive on him rather than where he lands — grounded, the dash never fires, then Fling him back in

edits.before: Dash backward with Relentless Pursuit the instant you drop Mega Adhesive so he lands outside the slow zone
edits.after: Dash out with Relentless Pursuit before your goo touches him — once he is standing in it, grounding locks him

edits.before: Your full kit is online but so is his kite pattern — the matchup hinges on whether you can bait Relentless Pursuit before committing Mega Adhesive.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit reads 16s but his Lightslinger shots keep cutting it — so land the goo first rather than counting, because grounded it will not cast.

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit 16-14s, but Lightslinger shots keep shortening it — do not count it, ground it. - Mega Adhesive 17-13s turns the dash off outright. - The Culling 110/100/90. - Insanity Potion 100s: kill windows.

notes: early contains the typo 'he simply Relentless Pursuits the moment you close range' (verb form of the ability name). I left the field alone rather than spend a length-locked rewrite on one word — it should be caught by a global name pass. The Culling is never mentioned anywhere on this page despite being a level-6 ability on 110/100/90; I added it to the cooldown block only, because I could not verify from Riot's text whether Fling interrupts it (the kit lists no channel flag for The Culling and I will not assert it either way).
